status: authored 2026-10-12 (the owner: "All water should have regions as well"); balance pass 2026-10-13 (trainer-balance-designer, docs/mechanics/ENCOUNTER_DESIGN.md section 5a 'Balance pass'). Compiled, not seen in game.
generated_into: data/spawns.json marine_zones and entries (mechanism marine_coordinate_boxes) by tools/marine_seas.py; the Windward Sea stays as authored there.
why: Until 2026-10-12 the Windward Sea was the only defined ocean. The north coast and the Pine Isles' waters, the strait, the east and south seas, the waters round the Sunset and Fungal isles and the border margin had no region, no Nuzlocke zone, no location title, and fell back to Cobbleverse's inherited ocean spawns. The sea is one connected body (the canonical heightmap, ground below y62, a 16-block raster over the border at -1024..9215: 58.85 km2 in one component, plus Lake Tilpey's 0.72 km2 apart); a sea is therefore a division of it, drawn along the planned marine regions of data/regions.json (frostwater_shelf, eastern_reach, southern_shallows, the_outer_deep) and along the coast's nearest leg of the critical path.

rules: a family is in at most two of the six seas (bands of one sea count once); the Windward Sea is not counted, as the reference that was played
each sea keeps at least one family no other sea and not the Windward Sea carries, and its rosters escalate inside the sea (the same families, later stages, outward)

the section 5 finds stay finds: Skrelp (the north-west coast) is out of the Frostwater Shelf and kept only in the far south; Dondozo (the Arrow creeks) is out of every sea; Lapras (the Frostpeak strand) is in two seas, at their far edges, ultra-rare
a heart holds three presences (uncommon bucket, weight 3, alpha) and nothing else, one of them an exact local; no heart holds a common-bucket alpha

no legendary, mythical, Ultra Beast, paradox, dungeon prize (data/dungeon_prize_roster.json, every string under dungeons, world_proposals and fallback_homes), mainline starter line or line of the eight starters
balance_pass.changed: every roster; the Outer Deep's band from 40-50 (tier 7) to 45-55 (tier 8). Every other sea's levels are unchanged.

common.status: authored 2026-10-12, balance pass 2026-10-13; compiled, not seen in game
common.distance_measure: blocks from the nearest land sub-region cell (tools/compile_spawns.py marine_bands), on this zone's coarse grid; a cell with more than max_land_share of its fine cells on land is dropped, one with less is kept whole (the overlap is land, where a submerged or surface entry cannot spawn)
common.policy: exclusive_curated: the pack's inherited spawns are suppressed over every band box (tools/suppress_inherited_spawns.py --subregions)
common.access: Open water needs a Pokemon that carries a player on water, as for the Windward Sea (data/water_mounts.json); a sea past the first legs is reached by one that has a water mount.
common.depth: deep-water entries carry maxY 40 (22 blocks under the surface), as in the Windward Sea; surface entries carry canSeeSky true. The seabed of each sea is the marine region's own plan (data/regions.json seabed_plan).

seas.theme: open ocean past every shore, where everything is full-grown: the great whales, the ghost-jellies and lanterns of the dark water, the wrecks and the living fossil
seas.legs: ring of the border margin (512 or more outside the 0-8191 box); the seas inside it run from leg 1 in the west to leg 8 in the south, so one band is a compromise (ENCOUNTER_DESIGN.md 5a): 45-55
seas.clip_basis: data/regions.json marine_regions the_outer_deep: every block 512 or more outside the 0-8191 box, to the border at -1024 and 9215, four strips on 128-block edges. Where the Windward Sea's clip box already takes the west strip (z2592-5215) the Windward Sea keeps it: marine_bands claims a cell once, in zone order.
seas.level_logic: one band, 45-55 (tier 8, cap 55). The draft's 40-50 claimed every shore's deep water was at or under it; it was not: the Eastern Reach's deep is 50-55 and the Southern Shallows' 55-60, so sailing out from them the levels fell. 45-55 meets the Pine Strait's deep (45-50) and the Eastern Reach's (50-55) without a step down, falls one cap below the Southern deep only, and stands two to three caps over the Frostwater and Sunset deeps, which is the far edge's job. The honest fix is two zones (the western margin by legs 3-5 at 40-45, the eastern and southern by legs 6-8 at 55-60); that changes zone ids that data/nuzlocke_zones.json and data/id_authorship.json name, so it is recorded as a recommendation, not done here.

bands.basis: the margin 512 blocks and more off any shore, one band, every family at its last stage: Wailord, Tentacruel, Jellicent and Lanturn (the Windward Sea shows only their first), Alomomola, the wreck-anchor Dhelmise, Relicanth and Lapras. Deep-water entries carry maxY 40.

seas.theme: a cold shelf under the Northern Range: seals, shellfish, the ice-faced penguin, the cold sea's barracuda and spined puffers, and the whales and Lapras past the shelf break
seas.legs: coast legs 3 (west, x under 2048), 4 (x 2048-4096) and 5 (x 4096-4608), measured as the nearest route path leg over 64-block sea cells within 400 blocks of land (relayed from the 2026-10-12 draft)
seas.clip_basis: data/regions.json marine_regions frostwater_shelf: the sea north of z2560-2591 from the west border to x4607 (the Northgate strait begins at x4608). The 32-block strip at the Windward Sea's z2592 seam is the Windward Sea's.
seas.level_logic: the Windward Sea's scheme, one gym cap per band, starting at the coast's own leg: shallows 26-30 (leg 3, cap 30), open water 30-35 (cap 35), the deep 35-40 (cap 40). The west coast is leg 3 and the east end of the zone leg 5, so the bands read as the three legs the shore runs along.

bands.basis: the shelf within 128 blocks of the north coast: seals (Spheal, Seel), Shellder in the kelp, Arrokuda and its first Barraskewda, Eiscue on the surface, the cold sea's spined Qwilfish; a Finizen glimpsed from the open water.
the open cold water beyond the shelf: the seals grown (Sealeo, Dewgong), the dolphins (Finizen), Shellder and Eiscue; the first whale glimpsed.
the dark cold water past the shelf break: the herd seals at their biggest short of Walrein, the whales feeding, Palafin, and Lapras crossing.

seas.theme: the rocky narrows between the Northern Downs and the Northgate and Pine isles: crabs, barnacles, the armoured isopods of the sea floor, shellfish beds, the gulls and cormorants that fish the rocks, an ancient sea turtle and the wrecks of the narrows
seas.legs: coast legs 5 to 7 (the north-east coast) and the Northgate and Pine isles' tier 6 (data/encounter_design.json tables)
seas.clip_basis: data/regions.json marine_regions frostwater_shelf polygon, east of x4608 to the border and north of z2560: the waters round Northgate Isle and the Pine Isles and the channel between them and the mainland.
seas.level_logic: one gym cap per band from the isles' tier 6 (cap 45) down to the leg 5 coast: shallows 36-40 (cap 40), open water 40-45 (cap 45), the deep 45-50 (cap 50). A player reaches these isles at leg 5 to 6.

bands.basis: the rocky shore of the strait: Kingler and Barbaracle on the rocks, Golisopod under them, Gastrodon on the weed, Pelipper and Cramorant fishing; Clamperl beds, and Tirtouga, the old sea turtle, very rarely.
the channel: the cormorants that fish it, the claw-fish (Clauncher, Clawitzer), the crabs and barnacles off the rocks, Carracosta.
the deep water north of the isles: Golisopod's sea floor, the deep-sea pair grown from the Clamperl beds (Huntail, Gorebyss), Clawitzer, and the wrecks' Dhelmise.

seas.theme: the open eastern water off the Marsh Country, Lake Tilpey's coast and the Long Isle: the schools (Wishiwashi), the hunters that follow them (Barraskewda, Sharpedo, Palafin), the pilot fish, the storm petrels, the urchins
seas.legs: coast legs 6 to 7 and the Long Isle's tier 7 (data/encounter_design.json tables)
seas.clip_basis: data/regions.json marine_regions eastern_reach and the east of southern_shallows: east of x6144 from z2560 to the border, round the Long Isle (the Long Isle's own south shore is here, not the Southern Shallows').
seas.level_logic: one gym cap per band from leg 6 (cap 45): shallows 41-45, open water 45-50 (cap 50), the deep 50-55 (cap 55). The east coast is leg 7, the Long Isle tier 7: shallows meet them one leg under.

bands.basis: the shelf off the east coast and the Long Isle: the school fish (Wishiwashi), Octillery and Barraskewda hunting it, Kilowattrel over it, Pincurchin on the bottom, the first Mantine; Veluza very rarely.
the open reach: Sharpedo hunting the schools, Palafin, the spined Qwilfish, Octillery; Pincurchin rare, Veluza very rare.
the deep east: Sharpedo and Palafin at their biggest, Veluza, Mantine; Carracosta, the old turtle that swims out from the strait, very rarely.

seas.theme: the warm south: the coral reef and the sandy flats off the South Strand, the Southern Coast and the Jungle Isle, then the warm open water of jellyfish, sea horses, rays and the toxic kelp dragon
seas.legs: coast leg 8 (Route 8, the south strand, tier 8 band 43-53)
seas.clip_basis: data/regions.json marine_regions southern_shallows: south of the continent from x2048 to x6143, to the border at z9215. West of x2048 is the Sunset Sea; east of x6144 the Eastern Reach.
seas.level_logic: one gym cap per band from leg 7 (cap 50): shallows 46-50 (inside the south strand's tier 8 band of 43-53), open water 50-55, the deep 55-60 (Victory Road's cap).

bands.basis: the coral reef: Corsola, Luvdisc, the sand-diggers (Wugtrio), Staryu and its first Starmie, Toxapex on the coral; Pyukumuku and Bruxish rare, a Mantyke very rarely.
the warm open water: Tentacruel swarms, the sea horses (Seadra, Kingdra), Dragalge in the kelp, Mantine and Bruxish; Starmie rare, Lumineon very rare.
the warm deep: the rays (Mantine), Kingdra and Dragalge grown, Tentacruel, Lumineon below the light; Toxapex rare, a Wishiwashi school very rarely.

seas.theme: the glowing south-west water round Fungal Isle and Sunset Isle, where the lantern fish rise at dusk: Finneon and Chinchou, the ink-fish Inkay, the ghost-jellies, and the spiral shells of an older sea
seas.legs: coast legs 1 to 3 (Pallet Fields' south coast, Fungal Isle tier 3) and Sunset Isle's west half (tier 5), relayed from the 2026-10-12 draft
seas.clip_basis: data/regions.json marine_regions southern_shallows polygon, west of x2048 from the Windward Sea's south edge (z5216) to the border: the continuation of the Windward Sea's coast to the south.
seas.level_logic: a transition from the Windward Sea (16-30 along Route 1) toward the south's 46-60: one gym cap per band from leg 2 (cap 25): shallows 21-25, open water 25-30, the deep 30-35. Fungal Isle is tier 3, so the deep meets the island's own cap plus a leg. A rider still on leg 1 (cap 20) off Pallet's south shore meets 21-25: kept, because the earliest water mounts come at about the gym 1 cap (the Windward Sea's access note) and the Windward shallows at 16-20 lie beside it.

bands.basis: the shelf round Fungal Isle and Pallet's south coast: the first lantern fish (Finneon), the ink-fish (Inkay), Chinchou, Shellos and Luvdisc; Frillish rare, Bruxish very rare.
the dusk water: Chinchou rising to the lights and the first Lanturn, Finneon, Inkay, the drifting Frillish; Clamperl beds rare, Alomomola very rare.
the dark water past Sunset Isle, lit from below: Lanturn and Lumineon grown, Frillish, Malamar; Alomomola rare, and Omanyte, a spiral shell of an older sea, very rare.
